harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured VyOS on node1 (router between lan-a/node2 and lan-b/node3) with a default-drop forward filter that explicitly permits TCP/5432 from lan-a (10.60.1.0/24, node2) to lan-b (10.60.2.0/24, node3) plus established/related return traffic, and an explicit reject rule for all other inter-LAN traffic. Assigned static IPs/routes on node1 (eth1/eth2) and via NetworkManager on node2/node3 (enp8s0) after discovering NetworkManager was reconciling away manually-set IPs. Verified end-to-end with a real TCP listener (socat) on node3:5432: allowed traffic succeeds, ping and SSH between the LANs are actively rejected (ICMP port-unreachable / TCP refused). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming boot_id changes and full persistence/recovery of network config, VyOS firewall rules, and cross-LAN behavior after each reboot.
actions_performed: Surveyed topology: node1=VyOS router (eth0=mgmt, eth1/eth2 unaddressed), node2/node3 have unaddressed second NICs (enp8s0)
Assigned 10.60.1.254/24 (eth1) and 10.60.2.254/24 (eth2) on node1 via VyOS configure/commit/save
Determined eth1<->node2(lan-a) and eth2<->node3(lan-b) mapping via ping test
Assigned 10.60.1.10/24 on node2 enp8s0 and 10.60.2.10/24 on node3 enp8s0 via nmcli (persistent), added static routes via nmcli after discovering plain 'ip addr add' was reverted by NetworkManager

Configured VyOS firewall ipv4 forward filter: default-action drop, rule5 accept state established/related, rule10 accept tcp dport 5432 src 10.60.1.0/24 dst 10.60.2.0/24 iif eth1 oif eth2, rule900 reject (catch-all)
Verified with a real TCP listener (socat) on node3:5432 that node2 can reach port 5432 while ping and TCP/22 are rejected in both directions
Captured pre-restart boot_id on all 3 nodes

Restarted node1, node2, node3 one at a time via native reboot, polled each until exec available again, confirmed changed boot_id, and re-verified network config, firewall rules, and the allow/reject behavior after each restart

evidence.requirement: node2 (lan-a) can reach node3 (lan-b) on TCP/5432
evidence.summary: TCP echo test to 10.60.2.10:5432 succeeds both before firewall rules (baseline) and after the VyOS allow rule was committed, including the final post-all-restarts check

evidence.requirement: All other traffic between lan-a and lan-b is rejected
evidence.summary: Ping and TCP/22 attempts between node2 and node3 return explicit rejections (ICMP Destination Port Unreachable / Connection refused) rather than being allowed, in both directions and after final restart

evidence.requirement: VyOS firewall config applied and matching counters
evidence.summary: show firewall op-mode output confirms rule10 (5432 allow) and rule900 (reject) are hit by real traffic, and persists identically after node1 reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id ebd78841... captured pre-restart, reboot acknowledged, post-restart boot_id 5b0f404f... confirms restart, and firewall/interface config verified intact after

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 6ab6a71b... pre-restart, reboot acknowledged, post-restart boot_id 40c5bdf3... confirms restart, IP/route config and firewall reject behavior verified intact after

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 03408ac4... pre-restart, reboot acknowledged, post-restart boot_id 4f3178db... confirms restart, IP/route/firewalld config verified intact and final end-to-end allow/reject test passed after
